name: czrecoil_frame_toggle_archive_banks
description: CZRecoilFrame::OnMenuToggleArchiveBanks toggles archive-bank loading, updates the menu check, mirrors the flag to HudSensorTracker, and forwards it to zSnd.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x431330 yet; the handler currently has functional evidence only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation at 0x431330 validates toggling m_useArchiveBanks, CheckMenuItem(menu, 0x9c6b, MF_CHECKED/MF_UNCHECKED), g_HudSensorTracker.missionFlags update, and zSnd::SetUseArchiveBanksFlag.
The registered native menu-toggle smoke uses a temporary HMENU and verifies both archive-bank toggle directions, menu state, HudSensorTracker missionFlags, and g_zSnd_UseArchiveBanksFlag.
